name: layer_review_queue_reason
description: Historical layer review reasons, retained with their original codes. The merged review_reason vocabulary now owns ReviewItem.reason and layer queue_reason.

definitions.ambiguous_statement: The submitted statement does not make an unambiguous judgement.
definitions.unverified_identity: The identity attached to the statement has not been verified.
definitions.insufficient_authority: The actor lacks authority for the requested judgement.
definitions.no_finding_id: The statement has no finding identifier.
definitions.undetermined_finding: Triage could not determine a verdict for the finding.
definitions.fp_audit_valve: A sampled automatically accepted machine false positive requires human audit.
definitions.needs_manual_test: A manual proof or live test is needed before deciding validity.
definitions.stale_baseline: The statement was made against an audit baseline that has changed.
definitions.rebaseline_mapping: A finding rename or rebaseline mapping requires review.
definitions.rebaseline_unmatched: A finding could not be matched during rebaselining.
definitions.unsound_refutation: A machine refutation was judged insufficiently sound to accept.
definitions.weak_confirmation: An E3 inference-only confirmation quarantined for stronger evidence or human review.
definitions.ungraded_confirmation: The confirmation supplies no evidence grade.
definitions.severity_proposal: A proposed severity change requires review.
definitions.needs_identity: The submitted finding has no fingerprint, so the receiver cannot identify which finding the statement concerns.

standard.none: Project-defined classifier vocabulary; existing meanings are retained.
